story.fullStory:
England Dan's "I'd Really Love To See You Tonight" reached #2 on the Billboard Hot 100. "I'd Really Love to See You Tonight" is a song written by Parker McGee and recorded by England Dan & John Ford Coley from their 1976 album Nights Are Forever.

2 on the Billboard Hot 100 chart for two weeks, behind Wild Cherry's "Play That Funky Music" and No.

Record World called it a "sparkling tune with its extraordinary melodic hook."
Dan Seals, the "England Dan" half of the duo, re-recorded the song in 1995 in an acoustic country version for the album In a Quiet Room.

The song peaked at #2 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 24 weeks on the chart.
